_: b314 — every editable field that matters → where it is meant to land → who reads it.
_why: POST /room-move wrote children.room_id and returned 201. Occupancy reads child_bookings.room_id. A round-trip test PASSES on that bug: write the field, read the field back, green. So this map records CONSUMERS, and scripts/b314-field-audit.js asserts against them, not against the field it just wrote.
_how_built: By reading the source, not by guessing. Form controls come from src/audit/control-inventory.json (scripts/b314-extract-controls.js). Destination tables and consumer endpoints come from src/audit/consumer-graph.json (scripts/b314-trace-consumers.js), which parses the SQL in every route file and attributes it to the endpoint it sits in.

_verdicts.PASS: wrote, every declared table changed, and every consumer now reports the new value
_verdicts.FAIL: wrote and landed, but a consumer still reports the OLD value — the room bug
_verdicts.PARTIAL: some declared destination tables changed and others did not
_verdicts.SILENT: the endpoint returned 2xx and not one declared table changed
_verdicts.UNMAPPED: a form control whose endpoint or destination could not be determined — an untested field, reported not skipped

open_findings.severity: medium — past dates only; today and the future are correct
open_findings.seen_as: 3 FAILs on 'GET /api/occupancy-calendar/grid — a PAST day must not move'
open_findings.what: child_bookings.room_id is one value for the whole booking period, and is_active is doing two jobs: 'not cancelled' and 'current'. Close-and-reopen (_propagateRoomChange) deactivates the old segment, and every occupancy loader filters is_active=true, so the child vanishes from the old room for every past date. An in-place room update on a booking rewrites the past the other way.
open_findings.why_not_fixed: The obvious loader fix (is_active=true OR end_date IS NOT NULL) is wrong on production: 38 inactive bookings carry source='attendance-derived' and an end date, deliberately superseded by the EyMan import. Including them would double-count last term.
options: small: stamp the closed segment (source='room-transfer-closed') and include only those in the date-aware loaders
proper: make is_active mean 'not cancelled' only, and make 'current' a date question in every booking reader

open_findings.severity: medium — a visible money field that changes nothing
open_findings.what: Roost > Children > edit child has a 'Funded Hours' number input (#f-funded in editions/admin/public/children.html) writing children.funded_hours. Every funding and fee calculation reads child_funding instead. On production not one child has children.funded_hours set — the column is vestigial.
open_findings.why_not_fixed: A single number cannot express what child_funding holds (term, type, universal/extended/stretched, eligibility code), so 'make it feed child_funding' is a decision about intent, not a translation.
options: keep it, label it, make it read-only
